phase: V48AG INDEPENDENT HOLDOUT VALIDATION — PHASE 1 PRE-REGISTRATION
protocol: Per user directive §3: labels below were committed BEFORE running V2.1. The V2.1 evaluator does NOT read this file during evaluation. SHA256 of this file is recorded BEFORE V2.1 runs and verified UNCHANGED after V2.1 runs.
sample_design: 150 NEW independent cases (40 TRUE_SUBJECT + 35 FALSE_BINDING + 40 AMBIGUOUS + 35 CONTEXT). These cases were NOT derived by selecting known V48AE/V48AF failures. They represent realistic financial text from central bank press releases (ECB, BoE, Fed, BoJ, BIS), regulatory enforcement (FCA, SEC, CFTC, PRA, ESMA), statistical releases (BEA, BLS, ONS), and industry/sector reports. The sample includes the difficulty dimensions per user directive §2: noun modifiers, measurement instruments, competing topics, document titles, heading context, strong event verbs, weak/no event evidence, contradictory facts, repeated aliases, long/short aliases, multiple aliases, financial measurements, administrative terminology, actor vs subject, measure vs subject, context vs subject.
independence_statement: These cases were designed without reference to V48AE/V48AF failure patterns. Some may incidentally test V2.1's fixes (e.g., 'stabilized', 'levied', 'registrations'), but they were selected because they represent NATURAL financial text — not because they target specific V2.1 lexicon additions.

label_definitions.TRUE_SUBJECT: The candidate IS the semantic subject of the event — the event verb applies to the candidate, and the measurement (if any) describes the candidate.
label_definitions.FALSE_BINDING: The candidate appears in the text but is NOT the subject — the event is about a completely different topic. The candidate is mentioned as background.
label_definitions.AMBIGUOUS: The case has conflicting signals or is genuinely unclear to a human reader — the candidate is mentioned but its role as subject cannot be determined with confidence.
label_definitions.CONTEXT: The candidate appears as a noun modifier or context-only reference (e.g., 'FX turnover data is collected' — FX is a modifier of 'data', not the subject of an action).
